page_title: CAG 2-1 ATA | Cagliari v Atalanta 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Antonio Rapuano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 2 - 1 Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
86' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Mitchel Bakker is replaced by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta).
86' Substitution. Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) replaces Alessandro Deiola.
83' The ball is cleared after Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will take a throw-in.
81' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) replacing Gianluca Gaetano.
79' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Tommaso Augello will be replaced by Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).
79' Here comes a substitution. Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Nahitan Nandez.
75' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
75' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is booked.
74' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
72' Emil Holm (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
71' Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
68' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
66' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Davide Zappacosta and he is replaced by Emil Holm (Atalanta).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) will replace Eldor Shomurodov.
66' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
63' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
63' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Simone Scuffet.
60' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Tommaso Augello (Cagliari), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
55' Here is a change. Teun Koopmeiners is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
55' Here's the change. Gianluca Scamacca leaves the pitch and El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.
54' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) receives a yellow card for infringement.
52' 3:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
47' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has made a change at the break. Mitchel Bakker has come on in place of Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
45+1' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) picks up a long through ball, but Marco Carnesecchi deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
42' 1 - 1 Goal Tommaso Augello (Cagliari)! Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) was put through by Eldor Shomurodov and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top of the net. 1:1.
37' Atalanta enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
35' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
34' There's a break in play and referee Antonio Rapuano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Cagliari using VAR. This could be interesting!
34' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cagliari for a penalty. Play continues.
28' The resulting corner, taken by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari), comes to nothing.
28' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Cagliari win a corner.

26' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
23' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
20' Ederson (Atalanta) produces a killer pass onto Davide Zappacosta, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
17' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
13' 0 - 1 GOAL! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Simone Scuffet, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:1.
12' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
10' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

6' Ederson (Atalanta) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
6' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) makes a strong challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
4' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
